nodes.question: Discord: client architecture and engineering mechanisms
nodes.why: An evolving landscape of source-inspected engineering mechanisms and open questions in Discord.

nodes.question: Message pagination and viewport anchors
nodes.mechanism_explanation: Tracks first/last message IDs, fetch anchors and pre-fetch scroll height. Pinned dimensions update immediately, unpinned updates are debounced. Focus, automatic anchors and jump-to-present are distinct.
nodes.transferable_insight: Separate data acquisition frontier from visible logical anchor.
distinctions: Discord Wiki history acquisition and keyed rendering.

references.role: Static inspected source; not runtime proof

nodes.question: Native input and editor reconciliation
nodes.mechanism_explanation: Tracks pending diffs/actions, composition and beforeinput target ranges; falls back to browser/logical selection. A guarded native simple-input path avoids preventDefault; other paths reconcile selection with setBaseAndExtent.
nodes.transferable_insight: Use native editing when invariants hold; explicitly reconcile exceptions.
nodes.qualification: Slate-related vendor code, active configuration not established.

references.role: Static inspected source; not runtime proof

nodes.question: Per-collectible fetch state and backoff
nodes.mechanism_explanation: Collectibles store maintains per-SKU backoff and fetch states. Hook guards on already loaded, fetching or backed-off conditions; success clears backoff, failure schedules expiry. Candidate registry chain 674658→590180→158390.
nodes.transferable_insight: Tie recovery to affected identity; gate at acquisition boundary.
nodes.qualification: Exact backoff class not yet read; parsed module links are lexical candidates.

nodes.question: Lazy locale loading and readiness
nodes.mechanism_explanation: Locale manager subscribes to changes, rebuilds formatters, uses Promise.all readiness barriers, per-loader import maps and promise/cache maps with fallback cycle checks. Tiny webpack factory demonstrates lazy locale import.
nodes.transferable_insight: Deferred acquisition plus per-key deduplication and explicit readiness.
distinctions: Lazy educational resources and domain atlases.

nodes.question: Error attribution through module metadata
nodes.mechanism_explanation: Sentry-related filter compares frame module metadata app keys against configured keys; supports drop/tag policies and strips metadata before envelope sending.
nodes.transferable_insight: Attach provenance at build time; classify with explicit policy.
nodes.qualification: Vendor code; active Discord configuration unknown.

entries.question: How does Discord load and scroll through message history?
aliases: How can older chat messages load without making the messages I am reading jump?
How can chat history load without making visible messages jump?
entries.context: Inspect the separation between message fetch anchors, pinned geometry and viewport intent. Restoration itself is still unexamined.

entries.question: How does Discord's message editor handle typing and composition?
aliases: Why does a rich text editor sometimes allow the browser to type directly and sometimes intercept typing?
How can an editor retain native input while maintaining a logical document model?
entries.context: Inspect guards on native input and selection reconciliation.

entries.question: How does Discord handle failed collectible requests?
aliases: How can failing requests avoid repeatedly hammering the network without blocking unrelated requests?
How can independent failing requests avoid creating network pressure?
entries.context: Inspect per-SKU state and caller guards; exact backoff algorithm remains open.

entries.question: How does Discord load translations when languages change?
aliases: How can changing language load only the needed text without exposing incomplete translations?
How can a language change load only needed resources without partially ready state?
entries.context: Inspect asynchronous readiness, cache and fallback-cycle checks.

entries.question: How does Discord's client distinguish third-party script errors?
aliases: How can an app tell which errors were introduced by outside scripts?
How can software distinguish its own errors from third-party errors?
entries.context: Inspect module metadata filtering rather than relying on exception message text.
